'''Sylva''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who lived on [[Telerath/Legends|Telerath]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Noua]]. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], she was employed at [[Ember's Fire]], a club owned by [[Ember Chankeli]]. On one [[Standard day/Legends|day]], Sylva was harassed by a patron sitting down to eat and drink. Sylva called for the help of [[Tam (Telerath)|Tam]], another worker, who pressed a button sending the angered patron through the floor and into a body of [[Water/Legends|water]] beneath the establishment.<ref name="BH2" />

Their boss, Chankeli, later reprimanded the two women for dropping a "paying customer," and was about to threaten them by withholding [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], when she was interrupted by the arrival of [[Dass Jennir]].<ref name="BH2" />
